name: Fencing
summary: Fence installation, replacement and repair for residential and commercial properties, including cedar privacy fences, board-on-board layouts, horizontal designs, gates, metal-post upgrades, staining and hauling.

faqs.question: Can you repair only the damaged section of a fence?
faqs.answer: Yes. Partial repairs may be practical when the remaining fence is structurally serviceable, the posts are stable and compatible materials are available.

faqs.question: When should a fence be replaced instead of repaired?
faqs.answer: Replacement may be a better option when several posts are failing, rot or storm damage is widespread, the fence is leaning throughout or repeated repairs would not provide a durable result.

faqs.question: Are metal fence posts better than wood posts?
faqs.answer: Metal posts are commonly selected for improved resistance to rot and soil moisture. The best choice depends on the design, budget, existing structure and local conditions.

faqs.question: Do you install gates and remove the old fence?
faqs.answer: Yes. Single gates, double gates, hardware, demolition, disposal and hauling can be included in the written project scope.

faqs.question: Can a new wood fence be stained or sealed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Staining or sealing can help protect the wood and create a more consistent finished appearance after the material has reached the appropriate condition for coating.
